workload: Guess Who wall: 80 Wikipedia people (DBpedia-14 test, artist/athlete/politician, seed 7, first 80) x 12 yes/no questions = 960 decisions; one request per bio

coreml.runtime: FluidUse KevCheck bios (KevFastManager, fused fp16, GPU), FluidInference/kev-0.8b-coreml@8fa70891, second launch

original_fp32.runtime: Kev Checkpoint.load(mps) default dtype, serving path (to_record -> encode -> forward), KEV_BACKEND=torch

notes: Peak memory footprint = /usr/bin/time -l (Activity Monitor's Memory). Core ML maps its fp16 weights from disk (clean, file-backed pages, not in the footprint); count them as resident for a conservative total (~2.1 GB). PyTorch on a Mac runs Qwen3.5's Gated DeltaNet and causal conv through transformers' reference implementations (flash-linear-attention / causal_conv1d kernels are not available there).
